messages:
maria: Quick q re canary fallback ordering when we route by cost vs latency for multi-tenant hosters. If primary model flaps, do we prefer fallback to cheaper quantized variant in same region or to remote higher-latency hosted fallback? Need deterministic priority.

devin: I think deterministic ordering per-tenant is key. weight prefs => prefer same-region lower-quality first. Also ensure KV cache reuse.

kai: proposal: a priority queue + cost cap. Each route has: {id, priority, cost_multiplier, expected_tail_ms}. The router dequeues first that meets tenant SLO.

samir: +1 but add health signals: p50/p95/p99, error-rate, queue-depth. fallback only triggers if both latency and error thresholds breached.

elaine: also add exponential backoff and cool-down window so we don't flip-flop. circuit-breaker => open after N failures or sustained p99 > SLO for M minutes.

ops-bot: deploy started: canary-rollout v3 -> 10% traffic -> tag=canary-2219876543 

maria: rough proto for policy (snippet):
```json
{"policy_id":"pq-compact-1","rules":[{"target":"redwood-7b-q4-std","priority":10,"cost_mult":0.4,"region_preference":"same"},{"target":"redwood-7b-fp16","priority":20,"cost_mult":1.0,"region_preference":"fallback"}],"signals":{"p99_ms":200,"error_rate":0.01},"cooldown_s":300}
```

devin: question: how to handle KV cache invalidation when switching models? we can't reuse cache across quantization formats.

kai: we tag cache entries with model_signature and kv_format. Router sends `cache_key_hint`. If mismatch => miss + async prefetch for new model variant.

samir: metrics to drive rollback: sustained >2x p99, error-rate>3% or inference-timeout count spike. Rollback action: route back + increase canary backoff.

elaine: ops automation: allow auto-rollforward after cool-down if metrics recover. But default = manual for prod until we've tested.

maria: ok actionable: (1) implement policy proto in router (2) add model_signature tag to cache (3) telemetry alert thresholds + runbook. Anyone object?

everyone: :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: canary v3 fully deployed to 10% at 2219876780

maria: thanks. I'll file follow-up RFC with the proto and runbook links.
